request:
镜头 s02：纪录片采访镜头，时长 10 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
风格模式：固定风格（style preset sp01-int78）。锁定外观 / Locked look（detailed_description 第一行必须照此书写，并逐字包含 ['Sony FX6', '50mm']）：Locked look "2078 oral-history interview" (style preset sp01-int78): a Sony FX6 on a locked tripod; S-Cinetone; a 50mm prime at f/2.8; filter Black Pro-Mist 1/8; grade: neutral, gently warm skin, background one to two stops under the face; light: one large soft key 45 degrees from frame left, negative fill on the right, a small warm practical in the background; texture: clean, fine detail, real skin texture; a calm, restrained oral-history interview, the subject looking past the lens.
该类型的纪录片默认机位：documentary talking-head interview, tripod camera, subject looks past the lens at the interviewer
导演意图（自然语言）：采访固定机位，极缓慢推近。宋念坐在金属椅子上，看着镜头外的采访者，平静地说完，最后微微抿了一下嘴。环境声：安静房间的底噪。
情绪：restrained, reflective, quietly heavy
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：medium close-up, locked-off interview camera with an almost imperceptible slow push in
景深与虚实：Shallow depth of field: her face is crisp, the concrete room and the warm lamp behind her melt into soft bokeh.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Oral-history interview medium close-up in a dim concrete room: Nian, a woman in her mid-thirties with straight shoulder-length black hair tucked behind her ears, wearing a plain dark knitted sweater, sits on a metal chair slightly off centre, looking past the lens at the interviewer, hands folded in her lap. Blocking lock: Nian sits on the metal chair at frame centre-left, angled slightly toward frame right where the unseen interviewer sits; soft key light from frame left; out-of-focus pipes and a small warm lamp in the background right.
Picture 2: Nian (Song's daughter, dispatch engineer, 33 in 2075, 36 in 2078) (character reference; role: the daughter, now grown up). A Chinese woman in her mid-thirties, dispatch engineer of an underground city: straight black shoulder-length hair tucked behind her ears with short side-swept bangs, calm guarded tired eyes, faint lines, a round face grown lean. Dark grey dispatcher uniform jacket with a high collar, a light headset around her neck.
Picture 3: the oral-history interview room (location reference; role: location reference). An oral-history interview set in a dim concrete room: one plain metal chair facing the camera, a single soft key light from the left, out-of-focus pipes and a small warm lamp in the background, a boom microphone tip at the top edge of frame. Empty chair, no people.
台词（逐字照抄，按顺序，每句放进一个 <d>[Chinese] ...</d>）：
1. Nian (a woman in her mid-thirties, low, calm, restrained voice) — 宋念（三十多岁女性的声音，低沉、平静、克制）: 我六岁那年问过我爸一句话。他笑了。二十七年后，它应验了。
服装锁定（本镜头，优先于参考图里的服装）/ Costume lock for this shot: Nian wears a plain dark charcoal knitted sweater; no uniform, no headset, nothing around her neck (the reference picture shows her 2075 dispatcher uniform; only her face and hair are taken from it).
现场环境声：quiet room tone, faint ventilation hum
参考词汇（检索所得，只借用术语与思路，不要整段照抄，不得改变锁定外观）：
[ours/cam-interview] 机位：采访固定机位
[ours/sound-room] 声音：采访间底噪
[rules/move/locked-off] move
[ours/light-interview-key] 采访布光：单一柔光主光
[rules/move/creeping-push] move
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。
